raw_refactor.scope: Compiled native PacketDecoder before/after the unwindowed-time extraction. Identical raw PCM bits, errors, discard decisions, truncation flags, sample counts and positions for every selected schedule. This does not claim vorbisfile seek parity.

experimental_controller.scope:
Experimental single-link/small-search controller, outside production.

Derives decisions from input bytes/headers and requests. Uses only native Rust
synthesis for runtime DSP. Retained C traces/output are consulted afterwards to
check decisions and PCM. Continuation/raw-seek and large bisection are pending.

fuzz.first_stream_run: Complete retained corpus replay; no new mutation units. Additional targeted streaming campaign requires new units.

instrumenter.scope: Generate and lint the diagnostic decoder copy only; no timing run. Copied modules share a complete isolated crate privacy boundary.
